title: Geometry of Straight Lines: Angle Relationships and Parallel Lines
seo_title: Grade 9 Geometry of Straight Lines Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and describe pairs of angles formed by perpendicular lines, intersecting lines, and parallel lines cut by a transversal; solve geometric problems using the relationships between pairs of angles, giving reasons.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 geometry worksheets: angles on lines, vertically opposite angles, parallel lines and angles with algebra. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Z: equal. F: equal. C: add to 180°.
key_sub: Give a reason for each step.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Angles on a straight line add to 180°; around a point to 360°.
  • Vertically opposite angles are equal.
  • With parallel lines: corresponding angles are equal, alternate angles are equal, co-interior angles add to 180°.
  • Give a reason for every step.

Examples

Example

Alternate angles 4x − 10° and 3x + 15°

4x − 10 = 3x + 15

Answer: x = 25°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Alternate or corresponding?Z: alternate. F: corresponding.
Co-interior equalThey add up to 180°.
No reasonState the angle rule you used.
